# `auth/entra.ts` API Reference

This module provides authentication utilities for integrating with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory). It wraps the MSAL (Microsoft Authentication Library) `ConfidentialClientApplication` to handle the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, including building login URLs, exchanging authorization codes for tokens, and clearing the token cache.

---

## Types & Interfaces

### `EntraUserProfile`

Represents the user profile returned after a successful token exchange.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `oid` | `string` | The object ID uniquely identifying the user in Entra ID. |
| `email` | `string` | The user's email address. |
| `displayName` | `string` | The user's display name. |

```ts
interface EntraUserProfile {
  oid: string;
  email: string;
  displayName: string;
}
```

---

## Functions

### `getAuthUrl`

```ts
async function getAuthUrl(redirectUri: string): Promise<string>
```

Builds an authorization URL for the Entra ID login flow. Redirect the user to the returned URL to initiate authentication.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `redirectUri` | `string` | The URI to which Entra ID will redirect after the user authenticates. |

#### Returns

`Promise<string>` — The authorization URL to redirect the user to.

#### Example

```ts
import { getAuthUrl } from './auth/entra';

const url = await getAuthUrl('https://myapp.example.com/auth/callback');
res.redirect(url);
```

---

### `handleCallback`

```ts
async function handleCallback(code: string, redirectUri: string): Promise<EntraUserProfile>
```

Exchanges an authorization code for tokens and returns the user profile.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | The authorization code received from Entra ID at the redirect URI. |
| `redirectUri` | `string` | The same redirect URI that was used when initiating the login flow. |

#### Returns

`Promise<EntraUserProfile>` — The authenticated user's profile.

#### Example

```ts
import { handleCallback } from './auth/entra';

const profile = await handleCallback(req.query.code, 'https://myapp.example.com/auth/callback');
console.log(profile.displayName);
```

### `logout`

```ts
function logout(): void
```

Clears the MSAL token cache.

#### Parameters

None.

#### Returns

`void`

#### Example

```ts
import { logout } from './auth/entra';

logout();
```

```ts

```
